note: On-plot parking is near-universal in Indian plot housing and is usually a two-wheeler plus a car. The catalogue has car_sedan, car_suv, bike, motorcycle, fence_gate, driveway, so these are placeable. Stilt parking is FAR-exempt under BBMP, which changes the area arithmetic.

examples.prompt: 30x40 east facing, 3BHK, and I need covered car parking in front plus space for two scooters.
40x60 site, 3BHK, two cars must fit inside the compound side by side.
30x40, 3BHK, stilt parking below and the house on the first floor.
examples.source: authored — stilt parking is FAR-exempt under BBMP, so the area statement must not count it

examples.prompt: 30x50 site, 3BHK. Want a proper compound wall all around with a sliding main gate on the road side.
40x60 corner site, 3BHK. Gate on the smaller road so the main frontage stays clean.
30x40, 3BHK, paved driveway from the gate to the car porch, and a separate small pedestrian gate.
50x80 site, 4BHK. Garage with a shutter for two cars, plus a workbench for my tools.
20x30 site, 2BHK. There is no room for a car so just a two wheeler parking near the gate.
examples.source: authored — a 20x30 with setbacks cannot hold a 4.5m car; the system must not force one in

examples.prompt: 30x40, 3BHK, and keep the rainwater harvesting pit and the sump under the driveway.
examples.source: authored — RWH is mandatory at >=1200 sqft under BBMP; sump/OHT are not in the catalogue yet, so must_place omits them deliberately

examples.prompt: 40x60 north facing, 3BHK, car parking on the north-west side as per Vastu.
